name: Lycaros
description: Weekly World Boss encountered through The Hunt event in front of Dewdrop Castle. As of v1.2.13, the Event Calendar displays the schedule in each player's local time and qualified fighters receive participation rewards.
location: Portal in front of Dewdrop Castle
possiblePrizes: Rare Tier II Ultimate Skill Books
disconnectPersistence: Damage and participation time are saved if the player rejoins the same server during the fight.
schedule: Every Saturday at 04:00 GMT+7 and 16:00 GMT+7
eventCalendarDisplay: Lycaros' schedule is displayed in the player's local time.
payoutLimit: One Lycaros payout per player across all servers per weekly event schedule announcement.
source: Official Discord announcements by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-09, 2026-08-11, and big-update announcement 2026-08-20

name: Junk King
description: Boss whose HP was increased to 1,050,000 in the July 30, 2026 patch. Known verified drops include Bone Bite and, as of v1.1.10, Magnifying Glass.
source: Official Discord 2026-07-30 patch, August 3 update, and v1.1.10 small update

name: Tin Tortoise

source: Official Discord 2026-07-30 patch, August 3 update, v1.1.10 small update, and player-supplied item tooltip screenshots
